comments.text: The spec lists two validation.rule artifacts for Currency.code (unique and format(3 letters)), and this single claim covers both. Task 1 has a criterion for uniqueness (A1) and an uncited one for the 3-letter format, so the claim is credible. However, the spec's P1 rule (rateToUsd > 0) is enforced in Task 1 but cited only through A2 with no stated mechanism. Name the mechanism, for example a Bean Validation constraint or a save hook, so the implementer does not have to guess where it lives.
